english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a librarian who works in or manages a library.

examples.english: I want to ask the librarian whether someone has borrowed this book.
examples.traditional: 我想問下圖書館員，呢本書有冇人借咗。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 man6 haa5 tou4 syu1 gun2 jyun4 ni1 bun2 syu1 jau5 mou5 jan4 ze3 zo2
